title: Concept: SSH authorized_keys file served
description: The file lists the identities that may log in to the host, with comments that name teams and automation. It tells the caller which accounts exist and which of them are machine accounts, which are usually the least monitored.
applicability: Responses that serve a home directory or a configuration backup.
risk: The caller enumerates the accounts that can reach the host, and the key types they use.
